items.title: Steve Angrum Interview, 1961-08-08
items.q: Well, I played with all, my Clayton's band, I played with him along with any band in the city.

ctx.x: Yeah, you'll do better. He'll do better. You're going to try to do better. But if you tell him he don't sound good, you done disgust the man. Yeah, he ain't going to do nothing then. And he will sound bad. Yeah. Yeah. Mm-hmm. Always tell him he's doing fine. And a man that sort of is needing a little pushing like that, you would play perhaps even more yourself to help him. That's right. To help him alone. Mm-hmm. In other words, you're all working together in the band. Working together in the band, but if he's…
What is that for water now? Who was your favorite trumpet player in those days that you liked to work with?
